items.title: Harrison Barnes Interview, 1959-01-29
items.q: That's one of the Jim Mumford band he had up there, too. They made good, that was before we came in.

ctx.x: Is it Lizard on the Rail? Is that what I'm saying? Yeah, yeah, yeah. That's the Howl Arthur is the name of it. They just put an ad voice to it. Yeah, yeah, Lizard on the Rail. With his tail. Yeah, they made it. That's one of the Jim Mumford band he had up there, too. They made good, that was before we came in.

Oh, talking about Frankie Dooson, somebody told us that he used to go down in the country, I believe on the other side of the river, and taught some of the bands, like Sam Morgan's band or something. Did you ever hear of Frankie Dooson teaching anybody or going around? He didn't know nothing about music itself.
